# DischargeX: AI-Powered Discharge Summary Generator

## Overview
DischargeX is India's first voice-enabled AI platform designed to automate hospital discharge summaries. It helps doctors create structured, professional discharge summaries in under 10 minutes, saving 30-50 minutes per patient.

## Key Features
- **Voice-to-Text**: specialized medical speech recognition that understands Indian accents.
- **AI Summary Generation**: instantly converts dictated notes into structured formats (History, Diagnosis, Treatment, etc.).
- **Multi-Department Support**: Works for Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, OBG, and more.
- **Editable & Flexible**: Doctors can review, edit, approve, and digitally sign summaries.
- **Integration**: Compatible with existing EMR/EHR systems; supports PDF export and WhatsApp sharing.
- **Security**: HIPAA compliant and data privacy focused.

## Benefits
- **Time Savings**: Reduces documentation time from 40+ mins to <10 mins.
- **Reduced Burnout**: Eliminates manual typing and copy-pasting errors.
- **Standardization**: Ensures consistent, high-quality documentation across all departments.

## Target Audience
- Hospitals (Small, Mid-sized, Multi-specialty)
- Individual Practitioners / Clinics
- Medical Residents and Junior Doctors

## Usage
Doctors open the web app/native app, select a department, dictate patient details, and the AI generates the summary. The doctor then reviews, signs, and prints/shares it.
